items.title: Major League Baseball structure (30 teams, 2 leagues, 6 divisions)
items.summary: MLB has 30 active franchises: 15 in the American League and 15 in the National League, each split into East, Central and West divisions of five clubs. Each club is a member of one division; division membership is fixed except for rare realignment.
